title: limnanthemum geminatum
intro: Limnanthemum geminatum, commonly known as Swamp Hibiscus, is a perennial plant native to Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Limnanthemum geminatum include its ability to reduce anxiety and depression, as well as its potential to protect against neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
